CONF-163935-1.text: 0b885b7f-2b42-41b1-8a5e-f0dc5e91cb27 :Growth_purple: #EAE6FF 🌱 Welcome to Confluence! You can use Confluence to create a rich knowledge base or to collaborate with others using words, videos, images, graphics, charts, and graphs. This page walks you through some Confluence basics like spaces, pages, and elements that allow you to create and manage impactful content for your teams. Confluence 101 https://www.loom.com/share/5149671332234032989863f520d133ed 🗃️ Spaces Spaces are where teams organize ideas, projects, and documentation. Spaces can be customized and integrated with both Atlassian tools and others. Spaces can be organized with folders , and you can drag and drop to reorder or nest content so you can more effectively share your work with others.
